definitions.gloss: detailed report; full account; in-depth coverage
definitions.explanation: A thorough and detailed report or account of an event, situation, or topic. Often used in journalism and official reporting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{詳報|しょうほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: A detailed report on the incident arrived.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{詳報|しょうほう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{朝刊|ちょうかん}→朝刊：16382_choukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掲載|けいさい}される→掲載する：19217_keisaisuru⟧。
examples.english: The detailed election results will be published in tomorrow's morning edition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{送|おく}って→送る：00742_okuru⟧きた{詳報|しょうほう}⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{当初|とうしょ}→当初：12503_tousho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧ようだ。
examples.english: According to the detailed report sent by the correspondent on the ground, the damage appears greater than initially expected.

notes:
Compound noun: {詳|しょう} (detailed) + {報|ほう} (report, news). Primarily used in journalism and formal reporting contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {詳報|しょうほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧ (to deliver a detailed report)
- {詳報|しょうほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (a detailed report comes in)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{速報|そくほう}→速報：14319_sokuhou⟧: breaking news, flash report — emphasizes speed over detail
- {詳報|しょうほう}: detailed report — emphasizes thoroughness and completeness
